title: Prompt Runtime Compliance Capture Mapping
purpose: Define and validate the lossless mapping from a provider-neutral runtime-compliance capture into prompt-runtime-compliance-receipt/v1 and only then into generic observed-behavior-proof/v1 references. The runtime-compliance capture is a separate typed source because the frozen compute-authority capture cannot represent boundary recovery without losing required information.

mappings.capture: boundary event, classification, checkpoint, publication ACK
mappings.observed_behavior_proof: observation references; rich event remains authoritative in the compliance receipt
observation references; rich action remains authoritative in the compliance receipt
linked evidence only; no duplicated regression semantics

mapping_invariants: Conversion is fail-closed when a required compliance field has no source mapping.
Rich boundary/action payloads remain authoritative in the compliance receipt and are referenced, not flattened away, by generic observed-proof artifacts.
An observed-behavior-proof/v1 claim may PASS only when the corresponding compliance receipt validates and the observed evidence class is strong enough.
target_runtime_observed is available only for a real external-agent execution, never a fake adapter.
The mapping preserves exact receipt ID, run/scenario identity, prompt/model/config fingerprint, and evidence references so P99/P13/P94 adapters can correlate without raw transcript persistence.
The compute-authority capture schema is not modified or treated as an interchangeable source schema.
Raw prompts, responses, transcripts, hidden reasoning, credentials, and secret-bearing payloads are never carried through the mapping.
proof_ceiling: Defines the required lossless capture-to-receipt-to-observed-proof field mapping and its fail-closed invariants. It does not implement the runtime capture, runner, or adapter (Sprint 3A) and does not prove any real runtime observation.
